publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.28 reduces Cloudflare D1 reads for cron and the console overview. The cron health check uses targeted notification schema checks instead of scanning sqlite_master on each cold run. With four one-minute monitors and 30 days of history, a cold run read about 193 D1 rows, down from 1,113. A full console overview request on a fixture with 300 retained deliveries read 690 rows, down from 69,872. Worker instances share conditional-request validators, so a second instance returned HTTP 304 for an unchanged overview in about 26 reads. The company setup guide covers when to install Uptime, importing existing monitor targets, the first Healthy result, and choosing a hosted cron schedule around D1 usage. When upgrading from 0.5.27, 0097_bound_notification_reads.sql adds indexes for notification and outbox queries. It wrote 605 D1 rows on the populated fixture and zero on replay. Earlier migrations are byte-identical. The @runeditrun/rer pin stays at 0.2.131. The backup and upgrade guidance under 0.5.26 still applies. Product screenshot available from 0.4.0 at .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-24.
